releases.name: v0.3.0 — Automatic text wrapping, overflow protection, and a full CLI manual
releases.notes:
## What's new

Text now adapts itself instead of being silently clipped, mixed CJK/Latin lines no longer collapse into a row of boxes, and the project finally has a reference manual.

### Automatic line wrapping

Subtitle, footnote (`-d`) and eyebrow (`-e`) lines wrap to the text area when they are too wide, so long copy no longer runs off the canvas and gets cut.

- CJK characters and full-width punctuation break per character, so Chinese wraps without spaces.
- Latin text breaks on spaces; a single word wider than the text area (long URL, hash) is hard-split by character as a last resort.
- Wrapping happens **inside each line you pass**: `-s` repeated still means separate paragraphs.
- On by default. `--no-wrap` (CLI) or `"layout": {"wrap": false}` (JSONC) restores the old single-line behaviour.

### Overflow protection

When the wrapped block is still taller than the available height, the subtitle and footnote font sizes step down proportionally, re-wrapping as they go, with a floor of 9px. Only if it still does not fit does `pixellogo` print a warning and continue:

```
pixellogo: warning: content is 810px tall but only 656px is available; font size is already at 9px, the rest will be clipped
```

The exit code stays `0`, so batch runs are not interrupted. Measured ceilings on a clean canvas (`title` 3–4 characters, subtitle only):

| Canvas | Lines that still fit |
| --- | --- |
| `poster` | ~30 |
| `square` | ~20 |
| `card` | ~16 |
| `slide` | ~13 |
| `banner` | ~8 |

`--badge` is a solid box, so it is not wrapped; it shrinks its font size instead when it would exceed the content width.

### Missing glyphs no longer take the whole line down

The bundled `ArkPixel-zh-hans.ttf` covers 18,648 of the 20,902 basic CJK ideographs (89.2%), and a few common characters are genuinely absent (「即」U+5373, 「然」U+7136, 「餐」U+9910). The old font picker gave up on the entire line when no single font covered it and fell back to the Latin font, which turned **every** CJK character on that line into a tofu box.

Now the line keeps the font that covers the most characters, and the characters that no font can draw are named on stderr:

```
pixellogo: warning: font ArkPixel-zh-hans.ttf has no glyph for 即; those characters will render as boxes
```

Both the warning and the font choice are also reported by `--dry-run`, so you can check before rendering. Pass `--font-title` / `--font-sub` / `--font-body` with any pixel TTF to cover a missing glyph.

### Documentation

- **[`docs/architecture.md`](docs/architecture.md)** — annotated three-level file tree, layer-by-layer module responsibilities, render data flow, and the constraints the architecture imposes (in Chinese).
- **[`docs/cli-guide.md`](docs/cli-guide.md)** — a full command-line manual: guided quick start, every flag, JSONC configs and batch mode, scripting and exit codes, plus a dedicated chapter on limits (characters per line, line ceilings, glyph coverage) and a troubleshooting table (in Chinese).

Both are linked from the table of contents and the new "Documentation" section of the English and Chinese READMEs.

### Packaging fix

`v0.2.0` wheels accidentally shipped a retired font (`ArkPixel12pxProportional.ttf`), because setuptools packaged from a stale `build/lib` snapshot. Release builds now start from a clean `build/`, so the wheel contains exactly the four fonts listed in the docs.

## Upgrade notes

- **Output changes only where text used to be clipped.** All 40 gallery samples produce byte-identical geometry; no images were regenerated.
- Wrapping is on by default: if you depend on a single overflowing line, add `--no-wrap`.
- `layout.wrap` is a new config key; the JSON Schema has been updated to match.
- `"uppercase": "false"` (a string) is now correctly treated as off instead of on.

## Install

```bash
pipx install git+https://github.com/sogeisetsu/pixel-logo-toolkit.git
# or
pip install git+https://github.com/sogeisetsu/pixel-logo-toolkit.git
```

Or grab an asset below: `pip install pixellogo-0.3.0-py3-none-any.whl`, or unpack the portable zip and run `pixellogo.cmd` / `./pixellogo.sh` with no install at all. Python 3.9+, Pillow for rendering.

## Tests

160 unit tests pass on Python 3.12 locally, and CI covers 3.9 / 3.10 / 3.11 / 3.12.

**Full changelog**: https://github.com/sogeisetsu/pixel-logo-toolkit/compare/v0.2.0...v0.3.0

releases.name: v0.2.0 — First release: bilingual CLI, English-first docs
releases.notes:
**pixellogo 0.2.0** is the first tagged release: a command line tool that turns a title, a few subtitle lines and a footnote into real 8-bit / retro-terminal pixel art — PNG and SVG from the same geometry, five canvases, ten palettes, and mixed Latin / Chinese / Japanese / Korean text without missing glyphs.

## Highlights

- **Real pixels, not a filter.** Text is rasterized into a binary mask and merged per row into integer-coordinate rectangles. Every edge stays a whole block at any zoom: no anti-aliasing, no gradients, no feathering.
- **One geometry, two formats.** PNG and SVG are produced from the same `Scene`, so they match pixel for pixel. The SVG is self-contained and needs no font files.
- **Five canvases.** `poster` 1080×1440, `card` 1440×1080, `banner` 1280×640, `slide` 1920×1080, `square` 1080×1080, each with its own layout strategy.
- **Ten palettes.** From retro terminal to paper journal; every preset passes a WCAG contrast check (`--list presets` prints the ratio).
- **CJK-ready.** A Chinese pixel font ships in the box, so mixed Latin/Chinese lines keep one stroke weight; Traditional Chinese, Japanese and Korean download on demand.
- **Bilingual CLI.** Help page, option tables, font status, warnings and errors in English or Simplified Chinese — automatic from the terminal locale, or forced with `--ui-lang`.
- **No browser dependency.** Pure Python and Pillow rasterization; runs on servers and in CI.
- **Reusable configuration.** JSONC files with comments and trailing commas, dot-path overrides, batch mode, and a `--dry-run` snapshot of the merged result.

## New in 0.2.0

### Bilingual command line

All terminal output now exists in English and Simplified Chinese: the help page, `--list modes|presets|fonts`, `fonts` status, warnings, and every error message (including argparse's own argument errors).

- Automatic: `LC_ALL` → `LC_MESSAGES` → `LANG` → `LANGUAGE` → Windows UI language → English. `C` / `POSIX` count as English.
- Explicit: `--ui-lang auto|en|zh` for a single run, or `PIXELLOGO_UI_LANG` as a persistent default. Precedence is flag > environment > locale.
- `--ui-lang` (CLI wording) is independent of `--lang` (glyph variant used for the image): `--ui-lang en --lang ja` gives an English interface with Japanese glyphs.

### English-first documentation

- `README.md` is now English and is the default entry point.
- `README.zh-CN.md` holds the Chinese version; the two are cross-linked.
- `pyproject.toml` metadata and the GitHub repository description are in English.

### Packaging and robustness

- Built distribution: wheel, source distribution, and a portable zip (see the asset table below).
- Missing Pillow no longer breaks the query commands: if Pillow is absent, `--version`, `--help`, `--list` and `fonts` still work, and rendering exits with code `2` plus an instruction to install it.

## Install

From this release:

```bash
pipx install pixellogo-0.2.0-py3-none-any.whl
# or
pip install pixellogo-0.2.0-py3-none-any.whl
```

From source at this tag:

```bash
pipx install git+https://github.com/sogeisetsu/pixel-logo-toolkit.git@v0.2.0
```

## Release assets

| File | What it is |
| --- | --- |
| `pixellogo-0.2.0-py3-none-any.whl` | Wheel. `pip install` this for a normal install; it adds the `pixellogo` command and bundles the five fonts, license texts and JSON schema. |
| `pixellogo-0.2.0.tar.gz` | Source distribution (sdist), for packagers or `pip install` from source. |
| `pixellogo-0.2.0-portable.zip` | No installation needed. Unpack and run `pixellogo.cmd` (Windows) or `./pixellogo.sh` (macOS / Linux). Contains the package, fonts, licenses, both READMEs and `RUNNING.txt`. |

GitHub also generates "Source code (zip)" and "Source code (tar.gz)" archives for every release. Those are raw repository snapshots and contain no built package — use the assets above if you just want to install and run the tool.

## Quick start

```bash
# One cover image, both formats, into out/
pixellogo -t "REA" -s "REVERSE ENGINEER" -d "One CLI for agents"

# A 16:9 slide cover in the cyber palette with a grid texture
pixellogo -t "PIXEL" -m slide -p cyber --bg-pattern grid

# Inspect what is available
pixellogo --list modes
pixellogo --list presets
pixellogo fonts
```

Running `pixellogo` with no arguments prints the help page; `--help`, `-h` and `pixellogo help` are equivalent.

## Command line at a glance

| Flag | Effect |
| --- | --- |
| `-t, --title` | Main title (required) |
| `-s, --subtitle` / `-d, --desc` | Subtitle and footnote lines, one flag per line |
| `-m, --mode` | `poster` / `card` / `banner` / `slide` / `square` |
| `-p, --preset` | One of the ten palettes |
| `--bg` `--fg` `--primary` `--accent` `--shadow-color` | Single-color overrides |
| `-f, --format` | `png` / `svg` / `both` (default `both`) |
| `-o, --out` | Output file or directory |
| `-c, --config` / `--set` | JSONC config and dot-path overrides |
| `--ui-lang` | CLI output language: `auto` / `en` / `zh` |
| `--lang` | Glyph variant: `zh-hans` / `zh-hant` / `ja` / `ko` |
| `--json` / `--dry-run` / `--open` | Machine-readable output / merged config / open the result |

Exit codes: `0` success, `2` invalid arguments or configuration.

## Python API

```python
from pixellogo import render, make_image, make_scene, to_svg_text

paths = render(title="REA", mode="banner", preset="cyber", format="png", out="out/")
image = make_image(title="REA", mode="square", scale=1)
scene = make_scene(title="REA", mode="poster")
svg = to_svg_text(title="REA", mode="slide")
```

Keyword names match the JSONC config keys exactly, so anything valid in a config file is valid here.

## Requirements

- Python 3.9 or newer
- Pillow 9.0 or newer (only runtime dependency)

## Testing

- 143 unit and integration tests (`PYTHONPATH=src python -m unittest discover -s tests`).
- CI runs the suite on Python 3.9, 3.10, 3.11 and 3.12, plus a job that renders real images on Linux.

## Known limitations…

releases.name: 3.0.1 — enforced candidate menu, per-source chains, comparing gate
releases.notes:
## What changed

3.0.1 closes the gap between what the README promised and what the code enforced. The short version: a Go model id can no longer be invented, chain length follows the source, Markdown agents can actually be written, the mode question is asked once, and `check` re-derives the numbers instead of trusting the file.

See [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/sogeisetsu/opencode-go-model-picker/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md#301---2026-11-03) for the full list. The Chinese changelog is at [zh/CHANGELOG-ZH.md](https://github.com/sogeisetsu/opencode-go-model-picker/blob/main/zh/CHANGELOG-ZH.md).

## Install this release

Download **`opencode-go-model-picker-3.0.1-min.zip`** below. It is the minimal package, not the GitHub "source code" archive:

- top-level directory is `opencode-go-model-picker/`
- it contains only `SKILL.md`, `references/`, `scripts/` and `LICENSE` — no tests, no docs site, no `assets/`, no `.git`, no `node_modules`
- 18 files

Extract it into your OpenCode skills directory so the folder name matches the skill name:

```bash
unzip opencode-go-model-picker-3.0.1-min.zip -d ~/.config/opencode/skills/
```

```powershell
Expand-Archive opencode-go-model-picker-3.0.1-min.zip -DestinationPath "$env:USERPROFILE\.config\opencode\skills"
```

Then ask OpenCode to check your agent models. The skill is read-only until you confirm a diff.

Requirements: Node.js 22+ (Node 18+ for everything except the local usage DB read), and OpenCode with Agent Skills support.

## Chinese documentation

- [README-ZH.md](https://github.com/sogeisetsu/opencode-go-model-picker/blob/main/README-ZH.md)
- [zh/CHANGELOG-ZH.md](https://github.com/sogeisetsu/opencode-go-model-picker/blob/main/zh/CHANGELOG-ZH.md)

## Verification

- `node --test tests/*.test.mjs` — 29 pass, 0 fail
- `node tools/check-docs.mjs` — 0 errors, 0 warnings
- the extracted package: `node --check` on every script, and `node scripts/go.mjs run --offline --json` against a real config (8 agents, 38 candidates, `quality=seed`)

en.headline: 76 own commits plus 31 automated; three releases published
en.summary: **76 own commits** were recorded across five repositories, plus 31 automated commits by `github-actions[bot]`. In `sogeisetsu/pixel-logo-toolkit`, 27 own commits added automatic text wrapping, overflow protection, bilingual CLI output, Korean font handling, and expanded documentation, and the `v0.3.0` release was published. The same repository also published `v0.2.0`, its first tagged release with a bilingual CLI, English-first docs, five canvases, ten palettes, and CJK font support. In `sogeisetsu/opencode-agent-sandbox`, 17 own commits tightened the `plain-language` skill, documented the development flow, and updated the role roster and routing rules. In `sogeisetsu/opencode-skill-management`, 16 own commits added the `starlight-docs` skill scaffold and templates, fixed mobile splash controls and external-link false positives, and added English and Chinese READMEs with an MIT license. In `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu`, 10 own commits updated release-note generation and daily-report wording, including action-count phrasing for PR and issue labels. In `sogeisetsu/opencode-go-model-picker`, 6 own commits enforced the candidate menu, per-source chains, and the comparing check gate, and `v3.0.1` was published. No pull requests, issues, reviews, or discussions were recorded.

releaseNotes.summary: Text now wraps automatically within each supplied line, with CJK breaking per character and long Latin words hard-split; `--no-wrap` and `layout.wrap` restore single-line behaviour. Subtitle and footnote font sizes step down proportionally to a 9px floor when content is still too tall, and missing glyphs are reported on stderr and by `--dry-run` instead of discarding the whole line. The release adds `docs/architecture.md` and `docs/cli-guide.md`, fixes stale font packaging from `build/lib`, and corrects the string value `"uppercase": "false"` to be treated as off.

This first tagged release introduces the `pixellogo` command line tool, producing matching PNG and SVG pixel art from one geometry across five canvases and ten palettes. It adds an English and Simplified Chinese interface via `--ui-lang` and `PIXELLOGO_UI_LANG`, ships a Chinese pixel font with on-demand Traditional Chinese, Japanese, and Korean fonts, and provides JSONC configuration, batch mode, and `--dry-run`. Documentation becomes English-first with `README.md` and `README.zh-CN.md`, and query commands such as `--version`, `--help`, `--list`, and `fonts` keep working when Pillow is missing.

The release prevents invented Go model ids, makes chain length follow each source, allows Markdown agents to be written, and asks the mode question once. The `check` command re-derives numbers instead of trusting the file, and the caveat section is allowed to be reworded while the check gate fails closed. The minimal package `opencode-go-model-picker-3.0.1-min.zip` contains 18 files with `SKILL.md`, `references/`, `scripts/`, and `LICENSE`, and requires Node.js 22+ except for the local usage database read.

releaseNotes.summary: 文本现在会在每一行传入内容内自动折行，CJK 按字符断行，超长拉丁词在必要时按字符硬切；`--no-wrap` 与 `layout.wrap` 可恢复单行行为。副标题和脚注在仍超高时会按比例缩小字号至 9px 下限，缺字字符会通过 stderr 和 `--dry-run` 报告，而不再让整行失效。该版本新增 `docs/architecture.md` 与 `docs/cli-guide.md`，修复 `build/lib` 导致的旧字体打包问题，并让字符串值 `"uppercase": "false"` 正确按关闭处理。

首个带标签版本推出 `pixellogo` 命令行工具，用同一套几何数据在五种画布和十套配色下生成相互匹配的 PNG 与 SVG 像素图。它通过 `--ui-lang` 和 `PIXELLOGO_UI_LANG` 提供英文与简体中文界面，内置中文像素字体并按需下载繁体中文、日文和韩文字体，同时支持 JSONC 配置、批处理模式和 `--dry-run`。文档改为英文优先的 `README.md` 与 `README.zh-CN.md`，缺少 Pillow 时 `--version`、`--help`、`--list` 和 `fonts` 等查询命令仍可使用。

该版本禁止虚构 Go 模型 id，链长度改为跟随各来源，允许编写 Markdown agent，并把模式问题改为只询问一次。`check` 命令会重新推导数字而不再信任文件，caveat 段落允许改写，同时检查门禁在失败时默认关闭。最小安装包 `opencode-go-model-picker-3.0.1-min.zip` 含 18 个文件，包括 `SKILL.md`、`references/`、`scripts/` 和 `LICENSE`，除读取本地用量数据库外要求 Node.js 22 以上。
